preconditions.description: The length of the permutations n must be between 1 and 2000.
Both permutations p and s must have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in s)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutations p and s must be integers from 1 to n.
Both permutations p and s must contain all unique integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the minimum number of coins required to transform p into s.
The second line of output must contain the number of operations k needed to achieve the transformation.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout.split()[i]) <= n and 1 <= int(stdout.split()[i+1]) <= n for i in range(2, len(stdout.split()), 2))
postconditions.description: Each operation must consist of valid indices i and j within the range of 1 to n.
The number of operations printed must match the specified number of operations k.
